messages:
alexa_marketing: Hey design — we need a set of benchmark visuals for the Redwood launch push and the webinar next week. Main asks: a hero chart for the blog post, a simplified diagram for the webinar slide, and a social card variant. Goal: make the performance vs cost story obvious and brand-compliant. Deadline: EOD in 48 hours. Figure link: https://figma.com/redwood/launch-benchmark (contains raw charts and notes).

jin_design: Got it. Quick q's: 1) do you want a single hero that we crop for socials or bespoke compositions? 2) do we have final numbers or should I mock with the CSV from eng? 3) any mandatory messaging copy to include? :thinking_face:

alexa_marketing: Prefer bespoke: hero (blog), webinar slide (16:9), social (square + twitter). Final numbers — Sam will drop a CSV. Copy — keep headline short: "Redwood Inference: 3x lower token cost at p95 latency" (workable placeholder). CTAs: "Read the benchmark" and "Register: Webinar". Use the new launch color palette (Olivia will confirm).

olivia_brand: Confirm brand constraints: use Redwood primary brand gradient as background accent, white logo lockup only on dark backgrounds, maintain 24px logo clearspace. Typography: Inter for headings, Source Sans for body. Please run all creatives through Brand QA before send. Assets: https://drive.redwood.com/brand-assets/launch-2026.zip

sam_eng: Dropped the CSV in the figma notes and also on internal share: `s3://redwood-internal/benchmarks/2026-q1/launch-benchmark.csv`. Columns: model, config, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, cost_per_1k_tokens_usd. Use p95 for the main callout and show cost per token as a secondary axis. If you need sample SVG charts, I can export.`

jin_design: Perfect — will pull CSV. Idea: hero will be a dual-axis bar + line: bars = cost, line = p95 latency. Webinar slide will be a simplified schematic: routing -> model variants -> fallback, with icons. Social card: single stat callout + small line sparkline. Draft specs I propose:```
hero: 1200x628 PNG, sRGB, 72dpi
webinar-slide: 1920x1080 PNG + exportable PPTX slide
social-square: 1080x1080 PNG
all: include alt text file and a short caption (1 sentence)
```

alexa_marketing: That layout works. Make two visual directions: "clean data-first" (white bg, gridlines) and "brand-forward" (dark accent gradient, bold callout). We may A/B test on Twitter and the webinar landing page.

olivia_brand: Approve both directions conditionally: the brand-forward must keep contrast >= 4.5:1 for body copy, headings can be large and bold. Send me PNG proofs at 1x and text layers flattened so I can inspect spacing.

jin_design: Timeline: I'll produce initial comps in ~12 hours, then iterate after brand QA. Where should final assets be uploaded?

sam_eng: Also adding a tiny ask: can the hero include an annotation that clarifies that numbers are internal-simulated workload and not production customers? Short footnote: "internal benchmark; configurations listed in notes."

alexa_marketing: Yes include that footnote in small type under the chart. Upload final assets to Marketing > Launch > Benchmarks in Drive. Ping me and @olivia_brand when ready.

designbot: Figma file updated: "launch-benchmark — jin_design" was created and shared with marketing@redwood.com. Review link: https://figma.com/file/ABC123/launch-benchmark

jin_design: Uploaded first two comps to the figma file and left comments on the data layers. Will also export a PPTX with the webinar slide. Tagging timeline: initial comps by 1769297000, final exports by 1769330000.

alexa_marketing: Thanks team. I'll coordinate webinar copy and landing page with growth. If anything blocks, DM me. :thumbsup:
